newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares climb, unmoved by government split.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares climb, unmoved by government split.

text.p: Danish share prices rose solidly to end higher on Friday, unaffected by the pullout of the small Centre Democrat party from the ruling Social Democrat-led government with dealers seeing more gains next week in a positive pre-Christmas market.
"The way things look on Wall Street just now, we're going to continue upwards on Monday," one dealer said.
The expiry of the KFX December future at noon filled the market with renewed life. The KFX top-20 index gained 1.18 point to close at 132.15 in overall bourse turnover of 1.668 billion crowns.
The KFX March future closed untraded at 132.85.
Danisco closed nine crowns higher at 350, Novo Nordisk closed two down at 1,040.
Leading banks Den Danske Bank and Unidanmark advanced, the former putting on five to finish at 457, the latter two crowns to end the week at 299.
